items.name: keep-together
items.title: Keep Together
items.description: The pagination unit. Content inside one is never split across a page break, and renders only on the page the plan put it on.

items.name: document
items.title: Document
items.description: Binds one form artifact and its data to the components beneath it. The only component that knows how the artifact is loaded.

items.name: bundle
items.title: Bundle
items.description: Groups the documents of one composition, mirroring the artifact hierarchy's outermost level.

items.name: part
items.title: Part
items.description: One document of a packet. It is the boundary between them, so each numbers its own pages and says where it sits in the packet.

items.name: pdf-pages
items.title: PDF Pages
items.description: A PDF part of a packet, painted page by page at its own paper size, or a named attachment card when it cannot be painted.

items.name: paper
items.title: Paper
items.description: One sheet at the document's page geometry, the scaled sheet the preview lays out, and the fit-to-width hook.

items.name: pages
items.title: Pages
items.description: Measures the document once and lays it out as paginated sheets. One tree, rendered once per page.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A titled container. It collapses on the pages that hold none of its keeps, so a continued page carries no empty heading.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One labelled value at a path into the artifact, printed by the artifact's serializers. It never formats a value itself.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A list field as rows. Each row is its own pagination unit and the header repeats on every page the table continues onto.

items.name: totals
items.title: Totals
items.description: The artifact's computed amounts, evaluated by @paradoc/core and printed by the serializer each def's type names.

items.name: signature
items.title: Signature
items.description: A party's signing block. Its rule is the placeholder the core seal measures a flow-placed signature field from.
